column2: my units die -> my other units or cards grow from each death
I die -> my Death effect acts (a unit worth more dead than alive)
I let my own unit die -> an enemy unit dies or is hit (a trade of units, never a gain of supply or strength: that is the Offering)
I damage my own units -> they act when hit, or something else gains
my dead units come back from the discard pile -> their Place acts again
my spent cards go from the discard pile back to deck or hand -> I play them again
I take my unit back to hand -> I place it again and its Place acts again
my Place or Death effect puts extra small units on the grid -> they fill cells and front cells cheaply (never round-end seeding: Rootkin)
I fill my camp with units -> cards that count my units grow
I place allies -> my units already on the grid react to each placement
my units stand beside, behind or around each other -> they give each other more
I move my own units inside my camp -> they reach the cells they need (front cells, beside an ally)
I move enemy units -> they leave the cells facing my dots, or stand where my cards hit them
my cards act in another lane -> one lane's strength or supply helps another
I claim cells -> my units on claimed cells gain, enemies there lose
my unit attacks -> its attack has an effect besides the hit
my unit hits for more than the enemy's defence -> the rest hits the unit behind
my unit kills an enemy -> it gains or acts again
I make my unit strike a chosen enemy, or make enemies strike -> removal by my unit's strength
small hits: my units' text and spells deal small fixed damage, often or many times (never round end) -> wounded and small enemies are finished
my cards hit every enemy in a row, column or area -> many enemies are hit by one card
I destroy an enemy outright, no damage -> its defence does not matter
my spells deal damage -> removal from the hand, no unit needed
I cast spells -> my units and later spells gain from each spell
my unit is hit and survives -> it grows or acts; the more it is hurt, the stronger it gets
I take an enemy's text away -> its keywords and abilities stop for good
I take an enemy's strength away for good -> it stays in its cell but hits for little
I turn an enemy into another unit -> its card is gone without dying
I act on the enemy's hand and costs -> his next cards cost more or are gone
I give the enemy useless cards -> his hand and draws fill with nothing
I gain extra supply or carry-over -> big units come early
my cards get cheaper or free -> two cards in one turn's supply
my cards grow in hand -> a bigger card for the same supply
I draw extra cards -> more choices each round
I create cards that were not in my deck -> more cards and answers
I copy my own cards -> a strong card twice
I pick cards of my deck -> the card I need comes when I need it
I discard my own cards -> the discarded card acts, or my units grow
I restore my units' defence -> wounded units hold the front cells longer
I give shields or armour -> the next hit does less or nothing
my unit guards my others -> enemy attacks must go where I choose
my unit can't be targeted or hit -> enemy attacks and spells can't reach it
I attach a unit or item to another unit -> the carrier gets its stats and text
at round start my cards act -> a plan set up last round pays at once
my unit leaves the grid (dies, returns, moves) -> my other cards react
my units have strength 5 or more -> cards that need big strength fire
I let my own unit die -> I gain supply, carry-over, a card or strength (the library's usual sacrifice)
I take an enemy unit or card for myself -> his strength becomes mine
I place my units in the enemy camp -> they hit his back row or block his cells from his side
my unit attacks the turn it is placed -> it removes an enemy before he can answer
my unit is readied or acts again -> one unit does two units' work
I mark an enemy or a cell -> my later hits on it do more
my units hit from afar (Ranged, long reach, over the front) -> enemies in the back rows are hit
